text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: SEV=critical - sudden 429 surge on /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate across eu-west-1 and us-east-1. PD incident PD-62481. Possible rate limiter or quota enforcement issue.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Notification sent to oncall SREs.
Maya Chen: acked. I'm taking first touch.
Raj Patel: I see the spikes on the dashboard, 02:11:32 UTC start. Error rate went from ~0.3% to ~14% for token-generation endpoints.
Maya Chen: copying charts: token-errors, rate-limiter-queue, quota-mapper-errors.
Lucas Rivera: quick check - limiter heartbeat shows some timeouts around the same time, seeing a bunch of "quota not found" logs. Could be the quota mapper returning nil for some tenants.
Maya Chen: running tenant query to find top offenders.
Lucas Rivera: paste of query:
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) AS errors
FROM request_logs
WHERE status_code = 429 AND timestamp >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Maya Chen: top 3 tenants account for ~78% of the 429s. They are high throughput customers but should be under reserved capacity.
Raj Patel: check quota-mapper service logs: I'm seeing repeated failures fetching quota config from etcd: "etcdrpc: request timed out" followed by quota-service returning default deny. That would explain sudden misapplied quotas.
Maya Chen: can we fallback quota source? Is there a cached config?
Lucas Rivera: there is a local fallback cache but policy currently set to "strict" which denies if fresh config can't be fetched. We can flip to permissive mode via feature flag to allow requests until etcd stabilizes.
Maya Chen: propose immediate mitigation: 1) toggle quota-enforcement.permissive=true 2) scale quota-mapper replicas from 2->6 3) temporarily increase token-bucket for the 3 tenants via quota-admin. Any objections?
Emma Liu: +1 to permissive flip. Need short window and audit. Make sure we record exact change for rollback.
Raj Patel: I'm executing the flag toggle. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://config.internal/api/v1/flags/quota_enforcement" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"permissive": true, "reason": "emergency 429 spike - fallback to permissive", "txn": "oncall-2060003456"}'
```
Maya Chen: confirmed flag change applied (permissive=true).
oncall-sre: reaction :white_check_mark: - flag change propagated to eu-west-1 and us-east-1 in ~18s.
Lucas Rivera: scaling quota-mapper now. `kubectl scale deployment/quota-mapper -n infra --replicas=6`
PagerDuty: Note: escalation paused while oncall handling.
Raj Patel: running quota-admin adjustments for top tenants:
```
quota-admin grant --tenant=t-42 --burst 2000 --duration=30m --reason="emergency mitigation"
quota-admin grant --tenant=t-99 --burst 1500 --duration=30m --reason="emergency mitigation"
quota-admin grant --tenant=t-7 --burst 1000 --duration=30m --reason="emergency mitigation"
```
Maya Chen: after changes: error rate dropped from 14% -> 1.4% within 2 minutes. Latency stable. Customer-facing errors reduced.
Emma Liu: thanks team. Open question: why did etcd time out? Could be control-plane load from recent config rollout.
Lucas Rivera: I'm pulling etcd metrics and network graphs now. Early signal: sudden spike in apply latency starting 02:10:45 UTC. There's a coincident config push from config-deploy at 02:09:50 that targeted a large keyspace.
Maya Chen: I'll keep incident and customer comms. Reached out to support to notify the three affected customers we're mitigating and will follow up.
Raj Patel: creating a short incident ticket PD-62481-triage with mitigation steps, artifacts, and timeline.
Incident Bot: Incident note added to PD-62481: "toggled quota permissive, scaled quota-mapper, issued temporary burst grants to 3 tenants".
Maya Chen: starting handoff to Emma in 30 minutes. Current status: degraded -> partial recovery.
Emma Liu: taking the handoff at 02:55 UTC. I'll continue analysis and ensure postmortem. Please drop any remaining logs into the incident timeline.
Maya Chen: captured the commands and timestamps in timeline. Next actions: root cause (config push vs etcd capacity), postmortem, tighten fallback (avoid strict-deny on config fetch), improve alert to separate 'quota-mapper unreachable' vs real token exhaustion.
Lucas Rivera: I'll put a short follow-up ticket to add a cached-allow policy and improve etcd autoscaling thresholds.
Maya Chen: thanks all. Closing immediate page. If anything flares, re-page. :thumbsup:
